hook: A $10,000 portrait of Houdini is up for auction today.

sections.voiceover: A $10,000 portrait of Houdini is up for auction today.
sections.visual_cue: Auction catalog page highlighting the $10,000 price.

sections.voiceover: Strand Magazine is publishing a lost Houdini essay for his centennial. Potter & Potter lists a lobby portrait at $5,000‑$10,000. Will the Harry Ransom Center reveal new clues about his Grace Hospital death?
sections.visual_cue: Magazine cover, portrait image, Harry Ransom Center façade.

sections.voiceover: But the essay also fuels fresh debate over whether his death was natural.
sections.visual_cue: Old newspaper clippings juxtaposed with the essay manuscript.

sections.voiceover: The portrait will be auctioned by Potter & Potter with a $5,000 opening bid. The Houdini essay now hangs at the Harry Ransom Center. It reignites debate over his 1926 death at Grace Hospital.
sections.visual_cue: Auction hammer, exhibition hall display, hospital sign.

sections.voiceover: The $10,000 portrait may vanish into history soon.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait fading into darkness as auction gavel falls.
